policies.name: agency_names
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ads.campaign_registration r
  WHERE (r.code = campaign_name.code)))

policies.name: agency_binding_check
policies.with_check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (ads.campaign_registration r
     JOIN ads.campaign_name n USING (code))
  WHERE ((r.code = native_binding.code) AND (n.name_id = native_binding.name_id) AND (r.status = 'REGISTERED'::text))))

policies.name: agency_bindings
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ads.campaign_registration r
  WHERE (r.code = native_binding.code)))

policies.name: agency_scopes
policies.qual:
(((status = 'ACTIVE'::text) AND (kind <> ALL (ARRAY['MULTI_PHASE'::text, 'ZONE'::text]))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ads.campaign_registration r
  WHERE (r.scope_id = scope_code.scope_id))))

policies.name: agency_members
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ads.scope_code s
  WHERE (s.scope_id = scope_member.scope_id)))

policies.name: published_export_pointer
policies.qual: ((published_version_id IS NOT NULL) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))

policies.name: assistant_citation_owner
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM internal.assistant_run r
  WHERE ((r.id = assistant_citation.run_id) AND (r.actor_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.actor_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid) AND (r.actor_role = current_setting('role'::text)))))

policies.name: assistant_tool_owner
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM internal.assistant_run r
  WHERE ((r.id = assistant_tool.run_id) AND (r.actor_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.actor_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid) AND (r.actor_role = current_setting('role'::text)))))
